query:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (
                          WHERE finished_at IS NULL
                            AND created_at >= now() - make_interval(secs => $2)
                      ) AS "in_flight!",
                      count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 hour') AS "hourly!",
                      count(*) AS "daily!"
               FROM agent_captcha_solves
               WHERE user_id = $1 AND created_at > now() - interval '1 day'
